visual_requirements.description: Preserve one bull head, two horns, two eyes, bovine muzzle and one sinuous coiling dragon-scaled body, smooth spine contour with no added spines, wings or limbs.
Preserve thick physical mist/cloud during rainy overcast weather and natural water splash, no magical glow.
Preserve Haizi waters in the western palace precinct beside the Jin'ao Yudong gateway, with architectural panels completely blank to obey no-text constraint.

prompt:

HARD FINAL CHECK: there must be ZERO text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, signatures, pseudo-inscriptions or watermark ANYWHERE, especially the upper-right gateway. Plain blank stone panels, not blurred or substituted writing. Preserve square native resolution at least1024x1024.
